messages:
Lena (PM): Quick design sync: need to finalize streaming controls for Playground. Two constraints: compact chrome and clear token visibility.
Sam (Design): Proposed: single pill that toggles Stop <-> Regenerate. In full view show label+icon; compact icon-only with aria label.
Priya (Frontend): Implementation question: how to handle focus/keyboard when label changes? Also where to place live token count during stream?
Diego (Eng): Backend supports abort + re-run. Regen needs prefix reset. No technical blocker for a toggle, but regen must be debounced server-side.
Jules (A11y): Accessibility notes: do not rely on icon-only for information. Update aria-label dynamically and announce end-of-stream via aria-live="polite". Token updates should use role="status" and not steal focus.
Sam (Design): Token idea: small floating mini-gauge near the pill while streaming, collapse to a badge on the message once finished. On mobile show inline badge to avoid occlusion.
Priya (Frontend): We'll throttle token updates to 500ms and animate value changes to avoid jank. Tooltip for compact mode needs aria-describedby fallback.
Diego (Eng): Edge cases: concurrent regen should return 429; client to show a small spinner/disabled state on the pill when regen queued. We'll add a regen_rate_limit field to the API.
Lena (PM): Copy: research favored "Regenerate" over "Run again". For compact avoid abbreviations like "Regen". Use icon+tooltip instead.
Jules (A11y): Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for counter animations. Ensure color contrast of token badge meets 4.5:1.
Priya (Frontend): Quick pseudo:
stream.on('token', n => throttled(500, () => setToken(n)))
ariaLiveRef.current?.announce(`Token usage: ${n} tokens`)

Sam (Design): I'll update the mock with spacing (8px gap between pill and gauge) and post the link.
Diego (Eng): +1. I'll update API doc with regen concurrency behavior.
Jules (A11y): +1. I'll run a screen reader pass once prototype is up.
QA Bot: Smoke tests queued for branch playground/stream-control-tokens  flaky: 3/80 failing.
Lena (PM): Thanks all. Follow-ups: Sam mock, Priya prototype, Diego API note. We'll review in next UX sync.
